strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
I see, so it's around here. The surface seems in chaos... Heheh,
but there's something to secure before any petty conquest by force.
I'll teach them the last laugh belongs to us, the Great Demon Empire...!
What!? The humans are on the move this fast!?
No. That's no human weapon...
Could someone besides us know that thing exists...!?
No choice. Machines are a poor foe for my first battle, but...!
Enemy attack! Battle stations!
Whoa, hold it right there! What brings you here, Mr. Invaders!?
Mister! This is no time for wisecracks!
I've sent a distress signal to the Gandor Team.
Hold out somehow until they arrive!
...Just us, against this many? You're kidding, right?
...That's how it'll be if Akira doesn't make it in time.
Where's Akira!?
He should be on his way... to the Brave One...!
Is this it!? Where the distress signal came from!?
Gandor, you made it!
A dragon...!? I see, so that's the Gandor I've heard about!
Far East Branch means Japan's Cyber Beast Force. We'll be fine, Mister.
This is Gandor, Hazuki speaking! Mutropolis, please respond.
Mutropolis?
A science fortress built to oppose the Demon Empire's invasion, huh.
This is Mutropolis. Thank you for the swift rescue.
The Big Shell here is safe for now, but the Copelander Team is in danger.
Please give them support.
Understood.
We'll repel the enemy forces now. Please fall back.
Whoa, don't underestimate us!
The Bluegar's loaded with everything from missiles to resupply gear.
We'll pass on watching from the sidelines.
Understood. We'd appreciate your help. ...All units, launch!
Hmph, a human warship. Interesting! More of a challenge than machines!
Ah, that's...!?
F-Flying Tanks... which means... it's those Bunker guys!
What's going on? You didn't call them here, did you!?
What was that? Don't go accusing people on a hunch!
Stop it, both of you!
That's right, Joe, it's embarrassing!
Let's just get out there, okay?
What are you doing! We're launching!
...Geez, are they gonna be okay...?
Dangaioh! Has! Arrived! Bunker battle mechs... I'll crush you!
What a transformation...
...That's beyond any split-personality issue.
Fade... Fade... Fade...
Nnnnhaaah!!
Hmm...! This reading... the one Lord Barao spoke of...
High-energy reading!? From where? ...From that face-shaped rock?
You're late! Akira!
Akira!
Raideeeen!! Faaaade In!!
Raaaideeeen!!
Another robot!?
It looks strong...
So that's... Brave Raideen... glimpsed only briefly in the last war...
The guardian god of the ancient Mu Empire...!
This power... a god...?
Cham?
Oh, no, it's nothing!
That light just looked like a light I saw in Byston Well.
Hahahaha! So you're the guardian deity!
Interesting...! Now learn the true might of the Demon Empire!
I see... the reason Raideen was calling me
was to warn me these guys had appeared! All riiight!
Commander Hazuki, you and us,
we both want to wipe out the invaders. Let's work together!
...Very well. I'll gratefully accept your offer.
All units, spread out and engage them one by one!
...So here you are... Dangaiohhh!
Whoa!? That's the one that wrecked Shinjuku...
That big one's tough. I hate that.
Wh-What is that thing!? Domon!?
Hmph, this unit sure has a knack for attracting trouble.
But it doesn't matter! I'll show you the power of the King of Hearts!
Nooo, he's so persistent!
...I won't give up so easily...!
Not until I've finished you and Tarsan with my own hands!
He sure hates you. What'd you people do?
...Well, a lot of things happened.
No time to dawdle. Here he comes!
Not once, but twice...! Dangaioh! And the Gandor Team...!
I won't forget this grudge! I won't forget it!
Tch, what a pathetic sore loser!
Gil! Why are you after us!? Even dragging this planet's people in...!
...Mia Alice, ask your own heart...!
He mentioned a Demon Empire, didn't he?
The Hyakki Empire appears, Mykene declares war... Too neat.
Yes, it might even be connected to Jaburo.
Jaburo... We've lost too much time, and things keep changing...
For now we just keep fighting. Koji must be doing his best too.
Geez... another new enemy? What the hell is going on?
Invaders are coming not just from space, but from underground too.
We're stuck in a sandwich! We ain't the lettuce or the ham, dammit!
Hibiki, was it? That robot of yours...
A robot revived after 12,000 years to stop the Demon Century...
That's Raideen.
Mutropolis was also built to oppose the Demon Empire.
So were we, the Copelander Team.
The Demon Century...? Who are they? What's their goal?
The Demon Empire is...
Akira, no sense talking out here.
Why not go with them and talk it over properly?
...You're right, Mister.
Commander Hazuki, please let Raideen's power be of use to you!
...Hm, but I can't just add a private army on my own authority...
Going through proper channels is impossible in this situation...
Let's be flexible here.
That's right, Commander. Given the situation...
We've got kids and even aliens here. It's way past being just military!
Big Bro's right, Commander.
Whatever, just hurry on to the next place, okay?
Besides, the more friends, the more fun!
You're the ones saying that...?
...Very well, come with us.
Commander Hazuki is turning into another Captain Bright, bit by bit.
Still, it's odd. The Demon Empire's revival seems unrelated, but...
